iran: Claims 2 ships struck · 4 turned back · Drones hit al-Jaber base, Kuwait
tldr: Iran claimed two ships struck and four turned back in the strait, and its army said loitering drones hit US facilities at Ahmad al-Jaber Air Base in Kuwait — the same morning Kuwait intercepted hostile drones entering from dawn, with debris damage and no casualties. Maritime pressure returned as the dominant mode.
dossier: Brent settled at $90.12 (+1%+) with WTI at $84.67, both up more than 20% for July. US officials told reporters fresh strikes on Iranian energy sites could come as soon as the weekend.
